OWNER MODE

Enter your 4-digit PIN to unlock editing. Everything you change saves right in this browser — no server, no monthly fee.

WRONG PIN — TRY AGAIN.

Resetting erases your custom photos and text and restores the original demo site (PIN back to 1234). There is no undo.

OWNER SETTINGS

SITE CONTROLS

PUBLISH

Loaded your photos and edited your text? Download a publish-ready copy of the site below — it has your photos and edits baked right into the file. Upload that index.html to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (no keys or special access needed) and it's live. Whenever you change photos later: edit, download again, re-upload the file. Visitors can never upload anything — the published site has no upload function at all; photos change only here, behind your PIN.

CHANGE PIN
LOGO (HEADER)

Got your artwork ready? Upload it here and it replaces the wordmark in the header — a transparent PNG works best. You can also leave it for later; the site is fully usable either way.

TRUCK PHOTO (LOAD METER)

The load meter shows your actual truck photo with two red fill areas — the trailer red covers 1/4 through FULL, and the bed red lights only with the PICKUP button (FULL fills the trailer alone). The chat link it streams from can expire, so upload your truck.JPG here once and it's embedded permanently. To fine-tune either red area, use "LINE UP TRAILER RED" / "LINE UP BED RED" in owner mode (under the photo) — the red fill follows your drag live, so you can see exactly where it lands before you let go.

BACKUP

Photos and edits live only in this browser. Download a backup before clearing browser data — or to move the whole site to another computer.

RESET

Wipes every edit and photo, restores the original demo content, and resets the PIN to 1234.

HOW IT WORKS
  • Click any text on the page to rewrite it — headlines, service lists, captions, phone, hours.
  • Two photo spots: the TOP STRIP under the hero (4 slots) and THE WORK further down (8 slots). Pick the target inside the ADD PHOTO window, or click an empty slot directly.
  • The load meter's trailer red covers 1/4 through FULL; the bed red appears only with the PICKUP button. LINE UP buttons place each red exactly; the red follows your finger live.
  • PUBLISH: after edits, download the publish-ready site and upload that file to your host — visitors see your photos and can never upload anything themselves.
  • Clicking a service row adds it to your quote request — click again to take it back off.
  • Saves are automatic — the "SAVED" note in the red bar confirms each one.
